summary: Rogue River NF ground cab on Buck Point, Jackson County: built 1953, trailer with cupola 1970, abandoned in the 1970s; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1970s (exact year not given) and now gone, per the register.

events.note: Willow Creek road work by the South Fork camp described as mainly for protection, but also aimed at developing Buck Point as a lookout fireman station.
Staffed 105 days; reports by telephone to the reporting station at Butte Falls.
Lookout house replaced by a trailer with a pop-up cupola; later removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says abandoned in the 1970s and now gone. The Forest Lookouts page says the trailer was used for a period and then removed, with no date. Both are consistent; the story gives no removal year.

notes_for_editor: The history is consistent across three sites (1953 ground cab, 1970 trailer, 1970s abandonment). The 1935 road item and 1941 staffing come only from the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes the Rogue River NF history vol. 2; the original was not checked. No source describes what remains at the site today, and no access information was found.
